scripts.lint: npm run --silent lint:js; js=$?; npm run --silent lint:css; css=$?; exit $(( js > css ? js : css ))
scripts.tokens:build: designsystemet tokens create --config designsystemet.config.json && designsystemet tokens build -t ./design-tokens -o ./design-tokens-build
scripts.tokens:verify: designsystemet tokens create --config designsystemet.config.json && designsystemet tokens build -t ./design-tokens -o ./.tokens-verify && diff -q ./.tokens-verify/digdir.css ./design-tokens-build/digdir.css && diff -q ./.tokens-verify/types.d.ts ./design-tokens-build/types.d.ts && rm -rf ./.tokens-verify && echo 'tokens:verify OK'

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: [ -f src/apps/web/scripts/hooks/pre-commit.sh ] || exit 0; cd src/apps/web && sh scripts/hooks/pre-commit.sh
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: [ -f src/apps/web/scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh ] || exit 0; cd src/apps/web && sh scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh
